precision.scope: CR pooled once on union of included M sets; also reported on each run M. MegaLens aggregate counts postings across included runs; runs are also separate.
precision.rule: Descriptive precision; no significance claim. Both unsure remains separate.

rules.catch: Both reviewers hit; incomplete or missing finals are misses.
rules.union: Logical OR of the two independently reviewerd run catches.
rules.verified: All extracted final-record verified findings, one audit per finding.
rules.contested: Different audit labels; both unsure reported separately. Bounds use W/V and (W+contested)/V.
rules.paired: A6 exact two-sided McNemar; no significance claim unless p < 0.05.
rules.matched: A8 M: real_review PRs with a completed final; unions need at least one completed run. Primary E: frozen catchable yes bugs on M; secondary: all bugs on M.
rules.sensitivity: All 43 real_review PRs; MegaLens non-completion is a miss.
rules.attempts: A9: quota admission refusals are separate harness failures; counted retries exclude them.
rules.pending: Absent reviewer output is an error unless --allow-pending; unknown rates have no interval.
rules.snapshot: Prepared inputs are immutable. --use-snapshot permits reporting the saved snapshot when live runs change.
rules.interval: 95% Wilson, z=1.96. Empty denominator has no interval.
rules.publication: Local operator artifacts; per-item identities and saved comment references are SHA-256 hashes.
